_note: Full Disclosure Policy (FDP) reports of the City of Mati. Records are archived copies of files the City posted on mati.gov.ph in 2016 (covering 2013–2014), opened and checked one by one; title and period are as printed on each document. Current postings live on the DILG FDP Portal and are not yet indexed here. type must be one of documentTypes.

documentTypes.name: Annual Budget Report
documentTypes.meaning: The approved budget: where the City expects its money to come from and how it plans to spend it.

documentTypes.name: Statement of Receipts and Expenditures
documentTypes.meaning: What the City actually collected and spent during the period.

documentTypes.name: Statement of Indebtedness Payments and Balances
documentTypes.meaning: Loans the City owes, what it paid, and what remains.

documentTypes.name: Quarterly Statement of Cash Flow
documentTypes.meaning: Cash coming in and going out each quarter, and the cash left at the end.

documentTypes.name: Annual Procurement Plan
documentTypes.meaning: Everything the City plans to buy or build during the year.

documentTypes.name: Supplemental Procurement Plan
documentTypes.meaning: Additions to the year's procurement plan.

documentTypes.name: Bid Results on Civil Works Good and Services and Consulting Services
documentTypes.meaning: Who won each public bidding, and for how much.

documentTypes.name: 20% of the National Tax Allotment Utilization
documentTypes.meaning: How the 20% development fund from the national allotment was used.

documentTypes.name: Report of Special Education Fund Utilization
documentTypes.meaning: How the Special Education Fund, from the property tax for schools, was spent.

documentTypes.name: Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund Utilization
documentTypes.meaning: How the disaster fund was used for preparedness and response.

documentTypes.name: Trust Fund Utilization
documentTypes.meaning: How money held in trust for specific purposes, such as national grants, was used.

documentTypes.name: Unliquidated Cash Advances
documentTypes.meaning: Cash advances to officials that are not yet accounted for.

documentTypes.name: Manpower Complement
documentTypes.meaning: How many people the City employs, by office and type.

documentTypes.name: Annual Gender and Development Accomplishment Report
documentTypes.meaning: What the City did under its gender and development budget.
